description: Crawl the user's website and add its pages to the AI agent's private training data. Same as the website step of web onboarding; no AI credits are used. Runs in the background; check progress with get_training_status. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

website.description: Public website or docs URL, for example acme.com.

name: start_website_training
title: Train the AI agent on a website
